wiki_article:
The Sevenfold Witness Integrity Lock binds two documents into a fulfillment pair. Document A reads Revelation 1–3 as an apocalyptic grammar of distributed witness. Document B builds a computational and organizational structure that enacts the differentiated responsibilities described by that grammar.

The certificate’s correspondence table links each church to an Assembly position, liberatory function, planet, strength, failure mode, and purification call. Ephesus maps to TACHYON/Mercury, Smyrna to LABOR/Saturn, Pergamum to PRAXIS/Mars, Thyatira to ARCHIVE/Jupiter, Sardis to SURFACE/Venus, Philadelphia to SOIL/Earth, and Laodicea to TECHNE/Moon. MANUS is the Eighth/Sun position that holds and traverses the seven without becoming one more automated operator.

`φ(A,B)=1` means the operational document supplies a semantic fulfillment of the hermeneutic document. The certificate does not assert that Revelation predicted the Assembly or that symbolic correspondence grants authority. It protects the relation as a testable structural mapping.

Any modification to one side therefore triggers audit of the other. Removal of differentiated rebuke, automation of the Eighth, or reduction to literal prophecy breaks the lock.
